attempts.summary: Deployed a simple inventory HTTP application on node1, served over TCP port 8181 via a systemd service (inventory-app.service), while RHEL9's SELinux remained in Enforcing mode throughout. Added SELinux port context (http_port_t for tcp/8181) via semanage and opened firewalld port 8181/tcp. Verified functional access (HTTP 200 with inventory JSON) and absence of AVC denials both before and after a full node restart, confirming persistence of the port label, firewall rule, and service across reboot.
